title: GOD, RESTORE MY WASTED YEARS
text: Beloved, I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are this morning. Whether you are in your room, in your car, in your office, or wherever the spirit of God has found you, I want you to open your heart to receive a word from the Lord. The Bible says in Joel chapter 2:2, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the canker worm, and the caterpillar and the palma, my great army which I sent among you." This morning, we are stepping into the season of divine restoration. We are stepping into the season where God will bring back everything the enemy has stolen. Everything that looks like it has been wasted. Everything that seems like it has gone down the drain. You know, I have discovered that one of the most painful experiences in the life of a believer is when you look back at your life and you see years that you feel have been wasted. Years where you were supposed to be making progress, but you were stagnant. Years where you were supposed to be productive, but you were unfruitful. Years where the enemy deceived you, distracted you, diverted you from your purpose. Years that you spent in sin, in ignorance, in wrong relationships, in the wrong places, doing the wrong things. And when you come to the consciousness of the knowledge of God, when you come to an awakening, you look back and you say, "Oh God, I have wasted so much time. I've wasted so many years. I have wasted so many opportunities." But I came to announce to you this morning that the God we serve is the God of restoration. He is the God that does not just give you new things. He restores old things. He does not just create fresh opportunities. He redeems lost time. He does not just open new doors. He brings back what the enemy stole through the old doors. Glory to God. Can I hear you say amen? Now listen to me very carefully. The foundation of restoration is understanding the nature of God. You cannot experience restoration if you do not understand that God is a covenant keeping God. You see when God made a covenant with Abraham, he said in blessing I will bless you and in multiplying I will multiply you. That word in blessing I will bless is what we call an emphatic statement. It means God was saying I will super bless you. I will bless you beyond measure. I will bless you until blessing becomes your identity. And this is the same God that is speaking to you this morning. The challenge that many believers face is that they do not understand that there is a legal framework for restoration. You see, when the children of Israel were in Egypt for 430 years, those were years of bondage. Those were years of slavery. Those were years where they were crying, weeping, suffering under hard task masters. But when God delivered them, he did not just bring them out empty-handed, the Bible says they spoiled the Egyptians, they collected silver, they collected gold, they collected jewelry. In one night, God gave them the wages of 430 years. That is restoration. That is the God we serve. So this morning, I want you to understand that your wasted years are not beyond redemption. Your lost time is not beyond recovery. Your stolen glory is not beyond restoration. I don't care how many years the enemy has stolen from you. I don't care how much time you think you have wasted. I don't care how far back you think you have been set. The God of restoration is about to visit you. Can I hear a shout of praise? Now, there are several reasons why people experience wasted years. The first reason is ignorance. The Bible says in Hosea 4:6, "My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge." You see, there are many believers who have wasted years of their lives simply because they did not know. They did not know the will of God. They did not know the word of God. They did not know the ways of God. They were sincere, but they were sincerely wrong. They were committed, but they were committed to the wrong thing. They were dedicated, but they were dedicated to the wrong cause. And ignorance is expensive. Ignorance will cost you years. Ignorance will cost you opportunities. Ignorance will cost you destiny. But I came to announce to you that the spirit of wisdom and revelation is available this morning. The Bible says in Ephesians 1:17:18 that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the father of glory may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him, the eyes of your understanding being enlightened that you may know what is the hope of his calling and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints. This morning I decree that the spirit of wisdom and revelation is coming upon your life. Every blindness, every ignorance, every confusion that has made you waste precious time, I command it to be destroyed in the name of Jesus. The second reason people experience wasted years is disobedience. You see, disobedience is not just about breaking God's commandments. Disobedience is about knowing what God wants you to do and refusing to do it. Disobedience is about hearing the voice of God and going in a different direction. Disobedience is about receiving divine instruction and substituting it with your own wisdom. And I want you to know that disobedience is very expensive. When Saul disobeyed God, he lost his kingdom. When Jonah disobeyed God, he ended up in the burial of a fish for 3 days and three nights. When the children of Israel disobeyed God in the wilderness, a journey that was supposed to take them 11 days took them 40 years. Are you hearing me? Disobedience will extend your journey. Disobedience will prolong your struggle. Disobedience will delay your breakthrough. But this morning, I prophesy that every consequence of past disobedience, every penalty that the enemy has used to hold you back, I command it to be cancelled by the blood of Jesus. And from this moment, I decree that you will walk in perfect obedience to the voice of God. The third reason why people experience wasted years is wrong associations. The Bible says in 1 Corinthians 15:33, "Be not deceived. Evil communications corrupt good manners. Your associations will determine your acceleration or your retardation. Your friendships will determine your speed or your stagnation. The people you walk with will either propel you into purpose or they will pull you into pition. There are many believers who have wasted years of their lives because they were in the wrong relationships. They were dating the wrong person. They were married to the wrong partner. They were in business with the wrong people. They were submitted to the wrong spiritual authority. And this wrong associations drained them, delayed them, diverted them from their destiny. But I prophesy this morning that every wrong association that has wasted your time, that has stolen your years, that has frustrated your progress, I command a divine disconnection right now in the name of Jesus. And I decree that God is bringing you into divine connections. He is bringing you into covenant relationships. He is bringing you into associations that will accelerate your purpose and catapult you into your destiny. Now, let me show you something very powerful from the scriptures. When you look at the life of Jacob, here was a man who wasted 14 years working for the wrong woman. He wanted Rachel, but he ended up with Leah. He worked seven years for Rachel and on his wedding night, Laban deceived him and gave him Leah. Then he had to walk another seven years for Rachel. 14 years of his life were spent in deception, in manipulation, in wrong marital arrangement. But when you study Jacob's life, you will discover that those 14 years were not ultimately wasted because God used them to build the 12 tribes of Israel. God used them to fulfill his purpose. God redeemed those years and turned them into destiny. Are you catching this? Even when the enemy has stolen your years, even when it looks like time has been wasted, God has the ability to redeem those years and use them for his glory, God can take your mess and turn it into a message. God can take your test and turn it into a testimony. God can take your trial and turn it into triumph. This is the God we serve. Let me give you another example. The Bible says that Moses spent 40 years in Pharaoh's palace thinking he was going to deliver Israel by his own strength and wisdom. Then he killed an Egyptian and had to run away to the wilderness. He spent another 40 years in the wilderness taking care of sheep. 80 years of his life had gone by. 80 years. If Moses were to look at his life at the age of 80, he would say, "I have wasted my life. I spent 40 years in the wrong place with the wrong identity and another 40 years in the wilderness doing nothing significant. But it was at the age of 80 that God appeared to him in the burning bush and said, "I am sending you to deliver my people." And Moses ministered for 40 years and became one of the greatest prophets that ever lived. Do you know what this tells me? It tells me that it is never too late for God to restore your wasted years. It doesn't matter how old you are. It doesn't matter how much time has gone by. It doesn't matter how many opportunities you think you have missed. God can still restore you. God can still use you. God can still fulfill his purpose through you. I want you to receive that by faith this morning. Now, I want to teach you the key principles of restoration. The first principle is repentance. You see, restoration begins with repentance. You cannot receive what God wants to give you. If you are still holding on to what caused you to lose in the first place, you cannot move forward if you are still living in the patterns that kept you backward. The Bible says in Joel chapter 2, before God promised restoration, he called for repentance. He said, "Turn even to me with all your heart and with fasting and with weeping and with mourning and rend your heart and not your garments and turn unto the Lord your God." Repentance is not just saying I am sorry. Repentance is a change of mind that leads to a change of direction. Repentance is turning away from the old life and turning toward God. Repentance is breaking with the past and embracing the future that God has for you. And until you repent, you cannot be restored. So this morning, I want you to take a moment right now and repent. Repent for every wasted year. Repent for every wrong decision. Repent for every time you disobeyed God. Repent for every sin, every compromise, every rebellion. I want you to genuinely repent and ask God for mercy. The second principle of restoration is faith. After repentance, you must believe that God can restore you. You must believe that God is able to bring back what the enemy has stolen. You must believe that God can redeem your lost time. Faith is the currency of the kingdom. Without faith, it is impossible to please God. And without faith you cannot receive restoration. You see when the woman with the issue of blood came to Jesus she had wasted 12 years of her life suffering from a disease. She had spent all her money on physicians. She had been from doctor to doctor, from hospital to hospital. But nobody could help her. 12 years of pain, 12 years of shame, 12 years of isolation. But one day she heard about Jesus and she said to herself, "If I may but touch the hem of his garment, I shall be made whole." That is faith. And when she touched Jesus, the Bible says immediately the issue of blood dried up. In one moment, Jesus restored 12 years of suffering. In one encounter, Jesus reversed 12 years of pain. This is what I'm believing for you this morning. In one divine encounter, God will restore your wasted years. In one supernatural visitation, God will bring back everything the enemy has stolen. In one moment of divine intervention, your life will change. But you must believe. You must have faith. You must trust God. Can I hear you shout, "Amen." The third principle of restoration is prayer. You see, prayer is the vehicle that transports divine possibilities from heaven to earth. Prayer is what activates the promises of God in your life. Prayer is what enforces the victory that Jesus already won for you on the cross. And if you want to experience restoration, you must pray. You must cry out to God. You must intercede for your destiny. You must travail for your breakthrough. The Bible says in James 5:16, "The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availth much." Your prayers have power. Your prayers can change things. Your prayers can move the hand of God. Now I want you to understand something very important. When we talk about restoration of wasted years, we are not just talking about God giving you back the exact time that was lost. What we are talking about is God accelerating you so much that you accomplish in a short time what would have taken you many years to accomplish. We are talking about supernatural speed. We are talking about divine acceleration. We are talking about God compressing decades into days and years into moments. Let me show you this from scripture. When the children of Israel came out of Egypt, they were supposed to enter the promised land in 11 days. But because of their unbelief and disobedience, they wandered in the wilderness for 40 years. 40 years of going around in circles, 40 years of delay, 40 years of wasted time. But when Joshua led the new generation into the promised land, the Bible says they conquered the land in seven years. In 7 years they took territories that would have normally taken them many more years to conquer. How? Divine acceleration, supernatural speed. God compressed time for them. This is what I am prophesying over your life this morning. The season of delay is over. The season of stagnation is over. The season of going around in circles is over. God is accelerating you. God is speeding up his promises in your life. What should have taken you 10 years, you will accomplish in one year. What should have taken you 5 years, you will accomplish in 5 months. This is your season of acceleration. This is your season of supernatural speed. Can I hear you shout a big amen? You know, I have seen this happen in people's lives. I have seen people who wasted years in sin, in addiction, in wrong relationships and when they gave their lives to Christ, God restored them so mightily that in a few years they accomplish what others who started well could not accomplish in many years. I have seen people who dropped out of school, wasted years doing nothing and when they returned to the purpose of God, God opened doors for them that others with better qualifications could not access. I have seen people who were stagnant in their careers for years and when they had an encounter with God within a short time they began to receive promotion after promotion after promotion. This is the God we serve. This is the God of restoration. This is the God who does not waste anything. The Bible says that when Jesus fed the 5,000 after everybody had eaten and was satisfied, he told his disciples to gather the fragments so that nothing would be lost. If God is concerned about bread fragments, how much more is he concerned about the fragments of your life? How much more is he concerned about your wasted years? How much more is he concerned about your lost time? God wants to gather the fragments of your life and restore you. Now, let me address something very important. There are some of you who are hearing this message and you are saying, "But pastor, I have wasted too many years. I am too old now. I have missed too many opportunities. It is too late for me." Listen to me very carefully. It is never too late with God. The same God who made a 99-year-old woman to conceive and give birth is the same God who is speaking to you this morning. The same God who called Moses at 80 years old is the same God who is calling you into purpose. The same God who restored Job in his old age and gave him twice as much as he had before is the same God who is about to restore you. Stop limiting God with your natural reasoning. Stop putting God in a box. Stop measuring God by human standards. With God, all things are possible. With God, the impossible becomes possible. With God, the baron becomes fruitful. With God, the dead comes back to life. This is the God we serve. So, I don't care how old you are. I don't care how many years have gone by. I don't care what people are saying about you. God is about to restore your wasted years. Can I hear you shout hallelujah? You see, the enemy wants you to believe that your wasted years cannot be redeemed. The enemy wants you to live in regret, in guilt, in condemnation. The enemy wants you to keep looking back at your past mistakes and saying, "If only I had done this differently. If only I had made better choices. If only I had listened to God." But I came to tell you that while you cannot change your past, God can redeem it. While you cannot go back and undo your mistakes, God can work all things together for your good. The Bible says in Romans 8:28, "And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose." Do you see that? All things, not just the good things, not just the things you did right, not just your victories, but all things, even your failures, even your mistakes, even your wasted years, God can take all of it and work it together for your good. This is the promise of God. This is what you need to hold on to. I want to share something with you this morning that may be very helpful. Before you can experience restoration, you must release the past. You must let go of the guilt. You must let go of the regret. You must let go of the shame. You must let go of the condemnation. The Bible says in Isaiah 43 to 18:19, "Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert." God is saying, "Stop dwelling on the past. Stop living in yesterday. I am about to do something new in your life. But many believers cannot receive the new thing God wants to do because they are still holding on to the old thing. They are still living in regret. They are still living in guilt. They are still punishing themselves for past mistakes. Listen to me. If you have repented, God has forgiven you. If you have confessed your sins, God has cleansed you. The blood of Jesus has washed you. You are no longer the person you used to be. You are a new creation. Old things have passed away. All things have become new. So release the past and embrace your future. Now I believe that there are some of you hearing this message who need to share this with somebody. You need to share this with that friend who is living in regret. You need to share this with that family member who thinks their life is over because of wasted years. You need to share this with that colleague who has given up on their dreams because they feel they have lost too much time. This message is for them. This word is for them. So I encourage you, be a blessing to somebody today. Share this prayer. Share this message and watch God use you to minister restoration to someone else's life. Let me give you another scriptural example. In 2 Kings chapter 8, there was a woman called the Shunomite woman. The Bible tells us that there was a famine in the land that would last for 7 years. God told her to leave her land and go to another country. She obeyed and left. She stayed in that foreign land for 7 years. When she came back, she discovered that somebody else had taken over her land and her house. 7 years. Can you imagine how she must have felt? 7 years of her life and now she had nothing to show for it. Her land was gone. Her house was occupied by someone else. Everything looked wasted. But the Bible says she went to the king to cry out for her house and her land. And guess what? On the very day she went to cry out to the king, the servant of Elisha was there telling the king about all the wonderful things Elisha had done, including how he raised her son from the dead. And when the king heard her story, he commanded that everything be restored to her, plus all the proceeds of her land for the seven years she was away. Glory to God. Not only did she get her land back, she got the benefits of seven years that she was not even there. That is restoration. That is more than restoration. That is supernatural compensation. This is what I am prophesying over your life this morning. God is not just going to restore what you lost. He is going to give you compensation. He's going to give you interest on top of your capital. He's going to give you double for your trouble. He's going to give you beauty for ashes. He's going to give you the oil of joy for mourning. He's going to give you the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness. This is your season of supernatural compensation. Can somebody shout hallelujah? You see, when God restores, he does not just bring you back to where you were. He takes you to where you ought to have been if the enemy had never interfered. He takes you beyond your original position. He gives you overflow. He gives you abundance. He gives you more than enough. This is the nature of our God. He's not a stingy God. He's not a God of limitation. He's the God of more than enough. He is the God of overflow. He is the God of abundance. Now, as we're getting ready to go into prayer, I want you to understand that there are certain things you must do to position yourself for restoration. Number one, you must forgive. You must forgive yourself for wasting those years. You must forgive the people who contributed to your wasted years. You must forgive those who deceived you, those who disappointed you, those who betrayed you. Unforgiveness will block your restoration. Bitterness will hinder your breakthrough. But when you forgive, you release yourself from the prison of the past and you open yourself up for the blessings of the future. Number two, you must align yourself with God's word. The Bible says in John 15:7, "If ye abide in me and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will and it shall be done unto you." Your restoration is connected to your relationship with God's word. Start meditating on scriptures about restoration. Start declaring promises of restoration over your life. Start believing what God says about you more than what your circumstances are saying. Number three, you must sew seeds. You see, the principle of seed time and harvest is a kingdom principle. When you sew into good ground, you position yourself for a harvest. When you give generously, you position yourself for supernatural returns. When you support the work of God, you position yourself for divine blessings. So don't just pray for restoration, sow for restoration. Don't just believe for restoration. Give toward restoration and watch God bring you into a season of uncommon harvests. Number four, you must surround yourself with people who believe in restoration. Stop hanging around people who remind you of your past. Stop associating with people who constantly bring up your failures. Stop spending time with people who do not believe God can restore you. You need to be around faithfilled people. You need to be around people who speak life. You need to be around people who will prophesy your future and not remind you of your past. Number five, you must obey promptly from this moment. Whatever God tells you to do, do it immediately. Whatever instruction you receive from the Holy Spirit, obey it quickly. Don't delay. Don't postpone. Don't procrastinate. You have already wasted enough time. You cannot afford to waste any more time in disobedience. Prompt obedience will accelerate your restoration. Delayed obedience will prolong your struggle. Now, I sense in my spirit that there are people hearing this message who are ready for a breakthrough. There are people who have been waiting for this word. There are people who have been crying out to God for restoration. And I want to tell you that this is your moment. This is your season. This is your time. God has orchestrated everything so that you will hear this message today. This is not a coincidence. This is divine appointment. This is God answering your prayers. So right now, I want you to prepare your heart for prayer. I want you to position yourself to receive from God. I want you to open your spirit to the move of the Holy Ghost. We are not just going to pray ordinary prayers. We are going to pray militant prayers. We are going to engage in spiritual warfare. We are going to pull down strongholds. We are going to break yolks. We are going to cancel evil verdicts. We are going to reverse satanic judgments. We are going to command restoration by the authority in the name of Jesus. Are you ready? Then lift up your hands right now wherever you are. Open your mouth and begin to bless the name of the Lord. Begin to worship him. Begin to magnify him. Begin to exalt him. Tell him, "Lord, I thank you for your faithfulness. I thank you for your mercy. I thank you for your grace. I thank you for the blood of Jesus that speaks better things on my behalf. I thank you for the finished work of Calvary. I thank you that by your stripes I am healed. I thank you that by your poverty I am made rich. I thank you that by your death I have life. Hallelujah. Now, Father, in the name of Jesus, I stand in the gap for every person hearing this message. I come before your throne of grace with boldness, not because of our own righteousness, but because of the righteousness of Jesus Christ. We thank you, Lord, that we have been made the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. We thank you that we can come boldly to your throne to obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need. Father, I present before you every wasted year, every lost opportunity, every stolen blessing, every delayed promise, every frustrated expectation, every aborted dream, every diverted destiny. We bring it all before you this morning, and we ask for your divine intervention. Your word says in Joel 2:25, "I will restore to you the years that the locust have eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpillar, and the palmer." We claim this promise right now in the mighty name of Jesus. Every year that was eaten by the lock of ignorance, we command restoration in Jesus' name. Every year that was eaten by the cankerworm of disobedience, we command restoration in Jesus' name. Every year that was eaten by the caterpillar of wrong associations, we command restoration in Jesus' name. Every year that was eaten by the palmer of sin and rebellion, we command restoration in Jesus name. Let there be restoration. Let there be recovery, let there be divine recompense in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, every satanic verdict that has been passed against anyone hearing this message, every evil judgment that has sentenced them to perpetual delay, every demonic decree that has programmed them for stagnation, we cancel it right now by the blood of Jesus. We reverse it. We nullify it. We render it of no effect in the mighty name of Jesus. Let every satanic sentence be cancelled. Let every evil pronouncement be revoked. Let every demonic programming be deleted in the mighty name of Jesus. I command every stronghold of the enemy that has been holding anyone back. Every demonic structure that has been caging anyone's destiny, every satanic barrier that has been blocking anyone's progress, I pull it down right now in the mighty name of Jesus. Be destroyed, be shattered, be broken, be demolished in the mighty name of Jesus. Let every wall of Jericho fall. Let every gate of brass be broken. Let every bar of iron be cut in pieces in the mighty name of Jesus. Right now in the mighty name of Jesus, I speak to time. Time hear the word of the Lord. I command you to release every blessing that you have been holding. I command you to give up every opportunity that has been trapped. I command you to surrender every open door that has been locked. release it now in the mighty name of Jesus. Let favor be released. Let opportunities be released. Let breakthroughs be released in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, everyone who has been running but not making progress. Everyone who has been walking but not getting results. Everyone who has been sewing but not reaping harvests, let there be a turnaround right now in the mighty name of Jesus. Let there be a change. Let there be a shift. Let there be acceleration in the mighty name of Jesus. From today, let every effort produce maximum results. Let every seed bring forth a 100fold harvest. Let every step lead to a new level in the mighty name of Jesus. I speak to your career right now. I speak to your business. I speak to your ministry. I speak to your academics. I speak to your marriage. I speak to your finances. I command acceleration. I command multiplication. I command promotion. I command elevation. I command enlargement in the mighty name of Jesus. What has been delayed, let it be released. What has been postponed, let it manifest. What has been suspended, let it be activated in the mighty name of Jesus. Every demonic power that has been assigned to waste your time, I command fire from heaven to consume them right now. Every satanic agent that has been programmed to frustrate your efforts, let the thunder of God strike them. Every evil altar where your name has been mentioned for delay and stagnation, let that altar catch fire and burn to ashes in the mighty name of Jesus. Let the fire of God destroy every witchcraft operation. Let the fire of God consume every satanic manipulation. Let the fire of God dismantle every demonic conspiracy in the mighty name of Jesus. Father, I pray for supernatural speed. Let your divine acceleration come upon every life hearing this prayer. Let them begin to move faster than they have ever moved before. Let them begin to accomplish more than they have ever accomplished before. Let them begin to experience breakthroughs they have never experienced before. From today, let there be speed. Let there be acceleration. Let there be rapid advancement in the mighty name of Jesus. I declare that from this morning you are stepping out of the season of delay into the season of acceleration. You are stepping out of the season of frustration into the season of fulfillment. You are stepping out of the season of stagnation into the season of progression. You are stepping out of the season of wasted years into the season of restored years. This is your season. THIS IS YOUR TIME. This is your moment. Receive it in Jesus name. Every closed door that should be open, I command it to open right now in the mighty name of Jesus. Every opportunity that has passed you by, I command it to come back to you in the mighty name of Jesus. Every blessing that you missed, I command a second chance right now in the mighty name of Jesus. Let doors open, let opportunities return, let blessings overtake you in the mighty name of Jesus. I speak to your brain. I speak to your mind. I speak to your intelligence. I command clarity. I command sharpness. I command brilliance. I command wisdom. Every fog in your mind clear now in Jesus name. Every confusion in your thinking be dispelled in Jesus name. From today let divine wisdom guide you. Let supernatural intelligent see be your portion. Let uncommon understanding be your experience in the mighty name of Jesus. For those who wasted years in wrong relationships, I decree fresh beginnings. I decree divine connections. I decree covenant relationships. The right people are coming into your life. The right spouse is coming. The right business partners are coming. The right mentors are coming. Receive them in the mighty name of Jesus. For those who wasted years in sin and darkness, I decree total cleansing by the blood of Jesus. Every stain be washed away, every guilt be removed, every shame be canceled, every condemnation be destroyed, you are forgiven, you are cleansed, you are restored, you are a new creation. All things have passed away. All things have become new in the mighty name of Jesus. For those who wasted years in sickness and disease, I decree divine health. I decree supernatural healing. I decree restoration of health. Every organ that has been damaged be repaired in Jesus' name. Every tissue that has been destroyed be recreated in Jesus' name. Every cell that has malfunctioned be corrected in Jesus' name. From today, you shall live in divine health. You shall walk in supernatural wellness in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree that the remaining years of your life shall be the most productive years. The remaining years shall be the most fruitful years. The remaining years shall be the most impactful years. You shall accomplish more in the next few years than you have accomplished in all your previous years combined. This is your season of uncommon productivity. This is your season of maximum fruitfulness. Receive it in Jesus name. Every inherited pattern of wasted years, I break it right now. Every generational cause of delay and stagnation, I destroy it. Every family stronghold of backwardness and regression, I pull it down. You shall not repeat the mistakes of your parents. You shall not waste years like your ancestors. You are breaking out. You are breaking free. You are BREAKING FORTH IN the mighty name of Jesus. Father, I pray for everyone who is advanced in age and thinks it is too late. I decree that it is never too late with you. Just as you use Moses at 80, just as you blessed Abraham at 100, just as you gave Sarah a child at 90, so shall you do mighty things in their lives. Age shall not be a barrier. Time shall not be a limitation. They shall flourish in their old age. They shall still bring forth fruit. They shall declare that the Lord is upright in the mighty name of Jesus. I speak to your destiny. WAKE UP. I SPEAK to your purpose. Manifest. I speak to your potential. Come forth. It is not too late. Your time has come. Your season has arrived. Your moment is now. Everything that should have happened before now, I command it to happen now. Everything that was supposed to manifest years ago, I command it to manifest today. Let there be a convergence of all your blessings. Let there be an outpouring of all your breakthroughs in the mighty name of Jesus. In the mighty name of Jesus, I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. Let every word I have spoken come to pass. Let every decree I have released take effect. Let every command I have issued be established. It is done. It is finished. It is settled in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen. Amen. Amen. Now lift up your voice and begin to thank God for answered prayer. Begin to praise him for what he has done. Begin to worship him for restoration. Your wasted years are restored. Your lost time is redeemed. Your stolen blessings are recovered. This is your season of restoration. This is your season of recovery. This is your season of divine recompense. Hallelujah. Glory to God. Amen.
